jobs.desc: World theme: HAUNTED GRAVEYARD at night: thick green mist, many crooked tombstones, ghost lights, a ruined chapel, an old iron cemetery fence. Wide side-scrolling 2D game BACKGROUND in exactly the art style of image 1 (rich pixel art, night, moody lighting). Layout rules (very important): the top edge of the walkable ground is a straight horizontal line at exactly 81% of the image height; the bottom 19% is a solid underground soil band with embedded rocks and a few bones. Always include these landmarks: a bare dead tree on the FAR LEFT with one thick horizontal branch; a big round glowing cream-colored moon in the upper middle; distant castle or tower silhouettes with a few small lit windows on the right; a long low fence or railing standing on the ground in the right half; three or four small grave-like stones on the ground in the left half. NO characters, NO creatures, NO text.
